title: ios-agent conversion report
description: Three-layer conversion-report schema. Layer A = blockers (must fix before ship). Layer B = manual review (compiles but suspicious). Layer C = learnings (cross-cutting patterns and stats). Validated by the bounded JSON Schema subset in converter/compliance/privacy_manifest.py — see x-validator-keywords.
x-update-policy: Field additions: bump x-schema-version minor; renderers must tolerate missing optional fields. Field removals or required-field changes: bump major and update every producer.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this schema. Producers stamp the version they were authored against.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp, second precision, trailing Z.

layer_a_blockers.description: Findings that block ship. Each must include a recommended fix.

layer_b_manual_review.description: Findings that compile but warrant a human look. Carry a per-symbol confidence score.

layer_c_learnings.description: Cross-cutting patterns the conversion saw, with refactor recommendations and (when rev > 1) trend deltas.

archetype.description: Source-side archetype, matches the compatibility-matrix vocabulary.

target_mode.description: Output mode. MVP only ships wrap.

root.description: Filesystem path or URL the conversion was run against.

rev.description: Conversion revision number. Starts at 1; increments on subsequent runs against the same target branch.

id.description: Stable identifier within a single report. Producer-prefixed, e.g. 'compliance.required-reason-api.userdefaults#0'.

producer.description: Module that emitted this finding, e.g. 'compliance.api_scanner'.

file.description: Repo-relative path. Synthetic findings (e.g. capacitor-plugin-derived) use a sentinel like '(plugins)'.

line.description: 1-based line number, or 0 for synthetic findings without a source location.

original_snippet.description: The matched source text, may be empty for synthetic findings.

attempted_translation.description: Producer's attempted translation, or null. Compliance findings always set null.

reason.description: Plain-English explanation of why this was flagged.

doc_link.description: URL to the canonical documentation for this finding.

confidence_score.description: Per-symbol confidence in [0.0, 1.0]. Layer A omits or sets null. Layer B carries a value. Range is enforced in the emitter, not the schema.

Provenance.description: LLM-translation provenance. All fields reserved for the Bridge/Port phases — every MVP producer sets null.

pattern.description: Short identifier for the pattern, e.g. 'localStorage-via-capacitor-preferences'.

occurrences.description: Number of times the pattern was seen in this run.

applied_translation.description: What the tool did with this pattern.

untranslatable_count.description: Of the occurrences, how many could not be translated cleanly.

refactor_recommendation.description: What the developer can change in the source to improve future conversions.

prior_rev_confidence.description: Aggregate confidence from the prior revision, or null if this is rev 1.

delta.description: Confidence change vs prior_rev_confidence, or null if not applicable.
